PF-10: Contract Revisions and Continuations

From the ORA eTraining module "Building the Project Team: Contractual Hiring and Compensation" (lesson 5 of 15).
PF-10s: When To Use Them?
Grant-Funded PF-10 Submissions
OHR guidance stipulates the PF-10 document is no longer to be used for new contractual employees. Now, PF-10s should only be used for contract revisions and continuations. For guidance on submitting an EPAF for a new employee please review the EPAF walkthrough lesson of this module.

Contract Revisions and Continuations
PF-10 Revisions: A contract revision might be submitted to change a contract's hourly rate, total salary, or end date. A contract revision must have the same start date as the originally submitted contract. PF-10/EPAF Continuations : A contract continuation can be completed either by EPAF or PF-10. When entered, the contract start date would reflect the additional contract start date. For example, a contract ending 6/30/24 would set the continuation start date to 7/1/24.
